title: Slow databases by query statistics
description: For each database_name with at least three measured queries, calculate average duration_ms rounded to one decimal place. Return exactly two columns: database_name, avg_duration_ms. Keep only databases with avg_duration_ms of at least 200. Sort by avg_duration_ms DESC, then database_name ASC for ties.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_duration_ms
FROM query_stats
hints: Both aggregate conditions—count and average—belong in HAVING.
You can use avg_duration_ms alias in ORDER BY.
solution_explanation: A group passes only when it has enough observations and a sufficiently high average duration.
